logic.summary: Two-way H4 EMA(5) vs EMA(20) Close: fast above slow holds a buy, fast below slow holds a sell; the opposite side is closed first.
logic.economic_rationale: Always-in-market H4 EMA regime follower monetises both up and down trends of gold with very low trade frequency.
known_assumptions: Evaluated once per new H4 bar on the last closed bar (shift 1).
Opposite side is closed before opening the target side (no self-hedge).
rejection_criteria: Short leg has negative Out-of-Sample expectancy after swap/spread.
Max drawdown exceeds the portfolio risk budget.
